candidate_contract.legal_definition: all status flags true: is_included, is_valid, is_placed_safe

terminal_step_metrics.com_contract: RAW quantity, not a score. The official cog_score normalisation is unpublished, so this cannot be compared across containers or configs and must never be presented as the official number. Comparable between arms on the SAME config only. com_height_ratio uses the tallest container's interior height as an arbitrary but fixed reference; lower is better in all three fields.
